title: PF0 user and decision-owner map
ownership_rule: Each consequential decision has one accountable role. One person may fill several roles in a small team, but the responsibilities and evidence remain distinct.

roles.name: Product owner
roles.accountability: Purpose, user priority, commercial scope, product acceptance and release authorization.

roles.name: Structural engineering authority
roles.accountability: Design-code interpretation, engineering applicability and acceptance of engineering assurance.
roles.current_assignment: Named qualified structural engineer before an engineering claim is approved

roles.name: Library architecture owner
roles.accountability: Shared semantic contracts, dependency boundaries, public API policy and Python/.NET parity.

roles.name: Python library maintainer
roles.accountability: Idiomatic Python projection, compatibility paths and Python package quality.

roles.name: .NET library maintainer
roles.accountability: Idiomatic .NET projection, C# implementation quality and package diagnostics.

roles.name: Excel product maintainer
roles.accountability: Excel-DNA adapter, workbook contracts, UDF/command separation and installed Excel acceptance.

roles.name: ETABS integration maintainer
roles.accountability: CSI adapter, source/model/result identity, axis and action mapping, and controlled model transactions.

roles.name: Independent assurance reviewer
roles.accountability: Independent examples, boundary cases, conformance review and evidence classification.
roles.current_assignment: Reviewer independent of the calculation implementation for the accepted operation

roles.name: Release owner
roles.accountability: Candidate identity, required software evidence, packaging checks and release execution.

users.name: Structural engineer working in Excel
needs: standalone beam definition, design and checking
visible missing inputs and governing cases
resolved reinforcement and an understandable calculation record

users.name: Structural analyst using ETABS
needs: reanalysis when a candidate changes the analysis model

users.name: Python engineer or researcher
needs: small calculations and whole-member services without Excel
stable migration paths from the existing package

users.name: .NET application or add-in developer
needs: ordinary .NET packages without an Excel dependency
idiomatic C# contracts that preserve shared engineering meaning

users.name: Detailer, estimator or construction-output consumer
needs: actual bar marks, layers and resolved lengths
reconciled BBS, quantities, formwork measurements and priced scope
traceability back to the checked member

users.name: Checker or engineering reviewer
needs: effective inputs, applicability and source evidence
distinct execution, engineering, completeness and freshness states

workflows.name: Standalone beam design in Windows Excel
workflows.trigger: An engineer has a project basis and beam data or standalone loading but no ETABS dependency.
workflows.completed_outcome: Current complete member checks, resolved reinforcement and a reviewable saved calculation/construction record.

workflows.name: Direct use from a Python script, notebook or service
workflows.trigger: A Python caller needs a small calculation, code check, member service or candidate evaluation.
workflows.completed_outcome: A typed result with explicit scope, effective inputs, engineering outcome and appropriate evidence, with no application host.

workflows.name: Direct use from a .NET application or service
workflows.trigger: A .NET caller needs the common calculation or member capability outside Excel.
workflows.completed_outcome: An idiomatic C# result equivalent in engineering meaning to the maintained Python operation, with no Excel dependency.

workflows.name: ETABS snapshot, design/check, candidate search, controlled reanalysis and comparison
workflows.trigger: An analyst selects an identified ETABS model and result state for beam checking or redesign.
workflows.completed_outcome: Compared candidates use current source-identified actions; model-changing choices have a new analysis snapshot from an identified copy.

workflows.name: Detailing, BBS, bar lengths, quantities, pricing, formwork measurement and reports
workflows.trigger: A checked member has resolved reinforcement and declared fabrication, measurement and pricing policies.
workflows.completed_outcome: All marks, lengths, quantities, prices and report items reconcile to the checked member and actual resolved geometry.

workflows.name: Reproduce, review, correct and approve an engineering record
workflows.trigger: A checker receives a calculation or construction record.
workflows.completed_outcome: The checker can reproduce the effective basis, see every required outcome, record corrections and distinguish engineering approval from software status.

decision_ownership.decision_area: Product purpose, user priority and desired outcomes
Design-code meaning, supported applicability and engineering acceptance
Shared semantic operations, public API policy and maintained common set
Excel workbook behavior and installed acceptance
ETABS acquisition, model transaction and reanalysis policy
